title: Efficient Resource Optimization for Split Federated Learning
abstract: arXiv:2608.17849v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Split federated learning (SFL) has emerged as a powerful paradigm for model training at the edge. However, SFL inherently involves discrete decision variables for model splitting and resource allocation, resulting in a challenging mixed-integer problem. Consequently, prior optimization schemes for SFL are either \textit{heuristic} or \textit{computationally inefficient}, which cannot handle large-scale user populations. To address this limitation, this work establishes an efficient optimization framework for SFL under resource-constrained networks. Our framework jointly optimizes model splitting and resource allocation to minimize training cost, which is defined as the weighted sum of latency and energy costs. We first study the model splitting problem and develop a polynomial-time algorithm that achieves the global optimum. translated_title: 高效资源优化用于分割联邦学习
translated_abstract: 分割联邦学习（SFL）已成为边缘模型训练的一种强大范式。然而，SFL固有地涉及模型分割和资源分配的离散决策变量，导致一个具有挑战性的混合整数问题。因此，先前针对SFL的优化方案要么是启发式的，要么是计算效率低下的，无法处理大规模用户群体。为解决这一局限性，本研究在资源受限网络下建立了一个高效的SFL优化框架。我们的框架联合优化模型分割和资源分配，以最小化训练成本，该成本定义为延迟和能量成本的加权和。我们首先研究模型分割问题，并开发了一种实现全局最优的多项式时间算法。然后，我们将该方法扩展到联合模型分割和资源分配问题。在这种情况下，我们公式化...
tldr: 本文提出了一种针对分割联邦学习的高效优化框架，通过多项式时间算法实现模型分割和资源分配的联合全局最优，以最小化训练成本并支持大规模用户。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an efficient optimization framework for split federated learning, achieving joint global optimal model splitting and resource allocation via a polynomial-time algorithm to minimize training cost and support large-scale users.
